interaction_history.overview: The popular 1980’s dance movie that depicts the life of an exotic dancer with a side job as a welder who true desire is to get into ballet school. It’s her dream to be a professional dancer and now is her chance. The film has a great soundtrack with an Oscar winning song.
interaction_history.title: Flashdance

interaction_history.overview: Contact is a science fiction film about an encounter with alien intelligence. Based on the novel by Carl Sagan the film starred Jodie Foster as the one chosen scientist who must make some difficult decisions between her beliefs, the truth, and reality.
interaction_history.title: Contact

interaction_history.overview: A psychotherapist journeys inside a comatose serial killer in the hopes of saving his latest victim.
interaction_history.title: Cell, The

interaction_history.overview: A girl who halfheartedly tries to be part of the "in crowd" of her school meets a rebel who teaches her a more devious way to play social politics: by killing the popular kids.
interaction_history.title: Heathers

interaction_history.overview: An unattractive 7th grader struggles to cope with suburban life as the middle child with un-attentive parents and bullies at school.
interaction_history.title: Welcome to the Dollhouse

interaction_history.overview: Cheated on, mistreated and stepped on, the women are holding their breath, waiting for the elusive "good man" to break a string of less-than-stellar lovers. Friends and confidants Vannah, Bernie, Glo and Robin talk it all out, determined to find a better way to breathe.
interaction_history.title: Waiting to Exhale

interaction_history.overview: George Bailey has spent his entire life giving of himself to the people of Bedford Falls. He has always longed to travel but never had the opportunity in order to prevent rich skinflint Mr. Potter from taking over the entire town. All that prevents him from doing so is George's modest building and loan company, which was founded by his generous father. But on Christmas Eve, George's Uncle Billy loses the business's $8,000 while intending to deposit it in the bank. Potter finds the misplaced money, hides it from Billy, and George's troubles begin.
interaction_history.title: It's a Wonderful Life

interaction_history.overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
interaction_history.title: Schindler's List

interaction_history.overview: Film about filmmaking. It takes place during one day on set of non-budget movie. Ultimate tribute to all independent filmmakers.
interaction_history.title: Living in Oblivion

interaction_history.overview: Three stories are connected by a Memphis hotel and the spirit of Elvis Presley.
interaction_history.title: Mystery Train
